speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief, brethren.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I turn the glass. That is the first turning, and it is not the last.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And fourteenthly, a parish may keep a feast and still keep its doors.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I am not come to the end of it. Sit.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He said brief. Mark me, he has said brief, and the glass is still up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He said he would be brief. He is not done.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Starch, brethren. Blue starch. Consider the lilies: they toil not, neither do they starch.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And that is not the end either. I will not be hurried by a dinner.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is he done, mistress?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He is not done. Sit still, and do not count for him.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am come, because not to come would be noticed. I will sit, and I will not add a word.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody has asked you anything, Gillis. Sit with the house.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sir John is in his pew. He has not spoken. I will not put a word in his mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There are halberds at that pew. I am not counting them.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I turn it again. Twice. You have not had the end of the matter.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A feast kept badly is a quarrel with the week. I have more to say of it, and I shall say it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Twice, and not once. You may go when I have said amen, and not before.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we wait for the amen. Alse, your eyes off the glass.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am not counting the sand. I am sitting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. Two turnings. That is the only number I am taking out of this church.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I heard two. I will walk home with the house, and no further matter.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. We go when he lets us, and not in a knot.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Amen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You turned it twice, Master Thwaite, and you were not brief.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I said we should be brief, and I turned it twice, and the parish has heard me. That is a Sunday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The close is across the yard. Dinner is a loaf. The loaf can wait until we are sat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will walk with you, mistress.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: And I with the house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we go. Sir John may sit. He has not spoken to me, and I have not spoken to him.
